description_en: Modifies the manual bypass switch for a hybrid cloud SDK integration cluster

name: ModifyHybridCloudClusterBypassStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID

parameters.help_en:
The manual bypass enabling status. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off (default): shutdown

off（默认）：关闭

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。
